[EN] Don't listen to the castanics. Sure, they're magnificent artisans, but they don't have a monopoly on talent. Some of the finest blades ever forged came from Kaiator.
[ES] No escuches a los Castanics. Claro, son magníficos artesanos, pero no tienen el monopolio del talento. Algunas de las mejores hojas jamás forjadas salieron de Kaiator.
